newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander sells BT 10 pct of Airtel - press.
newsitem.headline: Santander sells BT 10 pct of Airtel - press.

text.p: Spain's Banco Santander sold 10 percent of mobile telephone operator Airtel to British Telecom Plc, financial daily "Cinco Dias" reported on Wednesday.
A spokesman for Santander said it had no immediate comment on the report.

The newspaper, which cited unnamed sources close to the operation, added that Santander obtained some 50 billion pesetas for the sale of the stake, which would represent a profit of some 40 billion pesetas.
With this deal, BT becomes the principal shareholder of Airtel with a stake of some 7.15 percent, the newspaper said.
Santander continues to hold four percent of Airtel after the sale, but the newspaper said it would sell this remaining stake to BT as well.
Finally, the report said Santander would also dispose of 50 percent of the capital it has in BT Telecomunicaciones, a joint venture between Santander and BT.
